related.title: GRACE-FO 雙星編隊的距離觀測
related.transfer: 沿軌道幾何、姿態條件與地面可見窗口對照邊界。
related.transferEn: Compare boundaries across orbit geometry, attitude conditions, and ground visibility.
related.why: 兩課都要求可複查的軌道狀態與事件表；請先找到證據格式的共通欄位。
related.whyEn: Both courses require a reviewable orbit-state and event ledger. First find the evidence fields they share.
related.difference: 將絕對距離、微小差分及時戳誤差分開，估計量測時間精度。
related.differenceEn: Separate absolute separation, tiny differential changes and time-tag errors to estimate timing precision.
practice: 各選一個名義結果，保留輸入與來源。
對照介面、失效條件與資料解析度。
把一項驗證改編到另一案例，記下不可沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Select one nominal result in each case, retaining inputs and sources.
Compare interfaces, failure conditions, and data resolution.
Transfer a verification to the other case and document assumptions that do not carry across.

courses.overview: 比較軌道力學與飛行動力學中兩種案例的介面與驗證方法，並轉移一個工程判斷。
